hints.text: $x$ was divided by $4$ and the result was $9$. How do you get back to $x$?
Multiply both sides by $4$, which cancels the division on the left. The right side becomes $9 \times 4$.
$9 \times 4 = 36$, so the solution of the equation is $x = 36$.

explanation: $\dfrac{x}{4}$ means $x$ divided by $4$, and the quotient is $9$.
Multiply both sides by $4$, because multiplying undoes dividing.
The right side becomes $9 \times 4 = 36$, so the result is $x = 36$.
Check: $36 \div 4 = 9$ is true, so the solution is $x = 36$.
